title: Mischief Moves In
description:
Mischief has moved into the neighborhood!Welcome to the laid-back nighttime world of Mischief Moves In. You’re Mischief, a raccoon who has just moved into the neighborhood. But you have no furniture - so get out there and explore! Meet and lend a paw to other animals during your adventure, avoid humans, and collect furniture before heading home to decorate your new treehouse.  You’ve got the whole night ahead of you, so take your time, and don’t be afraid to cause some mischief along the way!

FeaturesDecorate your new home

Find and place furniture and other items in your new treehouse. After all that work decorating your new place, take some time to relax!

Help the locals

The local animals are a chatty bunch and would love to meet their new neighbor. Some could even use your help!

Avoid humans

Try to avoid getting caught by humans, they need their space.

Use special items

Obtain special items that may prove helpful as you explore.

Introducing Springs the frog

Invite your new pal Springs along for the adventure. He'll leap to help you in your adventure!

Explore!

Set out from your new forest home, Winding Woods, to explore Moonlit City, Snowdrift Mountain, and areas in between.

Collect!

Collect Acorns to purchase items for your treehouse and adventure at Susie Squirrel's Shop. Can you find them all?

You have the whole night ahead of you! 

Don’t forget to relax now and then. Live your best Raccoon Life!
description_short: Welcome to the laid-back nighttime world of Mischief Moves In. You’re Mischief, a raccoon who has just moved into the neighborhood. Find furniture to decorate your new home. Lend a paw to other animals during your adventure, and don’t worry about causing a little mischief along the way!
